description: Adds what is playing to Ty's music block list (todo.music_block_list) and skips it. The voice agent's tool for 'never play this again' (2026-11-04). With block 'artist' the whole artist is blocked. It finds the music speaker that is playing by itself (Whole House first, then the Family Room Stereo, HomePod, Kitchen and basement), so no song name is needed. From then on automation music_block_list_skip skips the song or artist the moment it starts, on any speaker, whatever started it. List items: 'Title — Artist' is a song, a bare name is an artist; Ty can edit the list in the app.

variables.player: {% set ns = namespace(p='') %}{% for e in ['media_player.whole_house', 'media_player.family_room_stereo', 'media_player.homepod', 'media_player.kitchen', 'media_player.basement_stereo'] %}{% if ns.p == '' and states(e) in ['playing', 'paused'] and state_attr(e, 'media_title') %}{% set ns.p = e %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.p }}

variables.title: {{ state_attr(player, 'media_title') | regex_replace('\s*[\(\[](feat|ft|with)[^\)\]]*[\)\]]', '', ignorecase=True) | trim }}
variables.lead: {{ (state_attr(player, 'media_artist') or '') | regex_replace('\s*(/|,|&| feat\.? | ft\.? | x )\s*.*$', '', ignorecase=True) | trim }}

variables.item: {{ lead if (block | default('song', true) | lower) == 'artist' else title ~ ' — ' ~ lead }}

if.value_template: {{ item | lower not in (list['todo.music_block_list']['items'] | map(attribute='summary') | map('lower') | list) }}
